_comment: Qubino: (1) ervenytelen (int32 MinValue) energiamero egyszeri nullazasa inditaskor; (2) root switch-uzenetek elnyomasa + endpointonkenti lekerdezes; (3) valtozas utan 1 s-mal visszaolvasas. (4) 15 percenkenti energia-lekerdezes.

ops.new:
-- st-edge patch: egyes Qubino relek energiaszamlaloja 0x80000000-at (int32 MinValue, x0.1 kWh =
-- -214748364.8) ad: "nincs ervenyes allas". Inditas utan egyszer nullazzuk az ilyen merot,
-- majd ujraolvassuk. Ervenyes allasu merohoz nem nyul.
do
  local StbMeter = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.Meter")({version=3})
  local stb_caps = require "st.capabilities"
  local stb_log = require "log"
  switch:call_with_delay(90, function(drv)
    for _, dev in ipairs(drv:get_devices()) do
      if dev.network_type ~= "DEVICE_EDGE_CHILD" and dev.zwave_manufacturer_id == 0x0159 then
        for comp_id, _ in pairs(dev.profile.components) do
          local e = dev:get_latest_state(comp_id, stb_caps.energyMeter.ID, stb_caps.energyMeter.energy.NAME)
          if type(e) == "number" and e < -1e8 then
            stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s/%s: ervenytelen energiaallas (%s) -> Meter Reset",
              tostring(dev.label), comp_id, tostring(e)))
            dev:send_to_component(StbMeter:Reset({}), comp_id)
            dev.thread:call_with_delay(5, function()
              dev:send_to_component(StbMeter:Get({scale = StbMeter.scale.electric_meter.KILOWATT_HOURS}), comp_id)
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end, "st-edge qubino energy fix")
end
-- st-edge patch: a Qubino ketcsatornas rele idonkent csatorna-jeloles nelkuli (root) switch-
-- allapotot kuld, amit a driver a main-hez (1. csatorna) rendel -> hamis "be". Ezert:
--  1) a root SwitchBinary/Basic report-ot/set-et nem dolgozzuk fel, hanem azonnal lekerdezzuk az
--     osszes csatornat endpointonkent (a valasz mar csatornahoz kotott, igy nincs hamis villanas);
--  2) biztonsagi halokent minden valodi allapotvaltas utan 1 s-mal az adott endpointot visszaolvassuk.
do
  local StbSwitchBinary = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.SwitchBinary")({version=2})
  local stb_log = require "log"
  local function is_qubino_multi(dev)
    return dev.network_type ~= "DEVICE_EDGE_CHILD" and dev.zwave_manufacturer_id == 0x0159
      and dev.profile.components.switch2 ~= nil
  end
  local function query_all(dev)
    for comp_id, _ in pairs(dev.profile.components) do
      if dev:supports_capability_by_id("switch", comp_id) then
        dev:send_to_component(StbSwitchBinary:Get({}), comp_id)
      end
    end
  end
  local disp = switch.zwave_dispatcher
  local orig_dispatch = disp.dispatch
  disp.dispatch = function(self, drv, dev, cmd, ...)
    if is_qubino_multi(dev) and (cmd.src_channel or 0) == 0
        and ((cmd.cmd_class == 0x25 and cmd.cmd_id == 0x03)                          -- SwitchBinary REPORT
          or (cmd.cmd_class == 0x20 and (cmd.cmd_id == 0x03 or cmd.cmd_id == 0x01))) then -- Basic REPORT/SET
      stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: root switch-uzenet (cc=0x%02X cmd=0x%02X) elnyomva -> csatornak lekerdezese",
        tostring(dev.label), cmd.cmd_class, cmd.cmd_id))
      query_all(dev)
      return
    end
    return orig_dispatch(self, drv, dev, cmd, ...)
  end
  require("st_bridge").on_event(function(dev, comp_id, cap_id, attr, value, prev)
    if cap_id ~= "switch" or attr ~= "switch" or prev == nil or value == prev then return end
    if dev.network_type == "DEVICE_EDGE_CHILD" or dev.zwave_manufacturer_id ~= 0x0159 then return end
    dev.thread:call_with_delay(1, function()
      dev:send_to_component(StbSwitchBinary:Get({}), comp_id)
    end, "st-edge verify " .. comp_id)
  end)
end
-- st-edge patch: a Qubino relek az energiaallast csak lekerdezesre kuldik -> 15 percenkent lekerdezzuk.
do
  local StbMeterPoll = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.Meter")({version=3})
  switch:call_on_schedule(900, function(drv)
    for _, dev in ipairs(drv:get_devices()) do
      if dev.network_type ~= "DEVICE_EDGE_CHILD" and dev.zwave_manufacturer_id == 0x0159 then
        for comp_id, _ in pairs(dev.profile.components) do
          if dev:supports_capability_by_id("energyMeter", comp_id) then
            dev:send_to_component(StbMeterPoll:Get({scale = StbMeterPoll.scale.electric_meter.KILOWATT_HOURS}), comp_id)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end, "st-edge qubino energy poll")
end
-- st-edge patch: az egycsatornas Qubino rele (Hall lamp, 0159-0002-0052) kezi kapcsolaskor semmit nem
-- kuld, allapota csak a hid 10 perces refresh-ere frissul -> hianyzo lifeline (group 1) asszociacio.
--  1) inditas utan 2 perccel (es 30 percenkent: a lifeline idonkent kiurul) lekerdezzuk az 1. csoportot (sima + multichannel), a
--     valaszt naplozzuk; ha a hub egyikben sincs benne, Association Set group 1 = hub, majd ujraolvasas;
--  2) halo: ha a teljesitmeny ellentmond a kapcsoloallapotnak (>= 3 W de "off", < 1 W de "on"),
--     azonnal visszaolvassuk a kapcsolot.
do
  local StbAssoc = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.Association")({version=2})
  local StbMca = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.MultiChannelAssociation")({version=2})
  local StbSwitchBinary = (require "st.zwave.CommandClass.SwitchBinary")({version=2})
  local stb_log = require "log"
  local function is_qubino_single(dev)
    return dev.network_type ~= "DEVICE_EDGE_CHILD" and dev.zwave_manufacturer_id == 0x0159
      and dev.zwave_product_type == 0x0002 and dev.profile.components.switch2 == nil
  end
  local function hub_id(drv) return drv.environment_info.hub_zwave_id or 1 end
  local function ids_str(t)
    local s = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(t or {}) do
      s[#s + 1] = type(v) == "table" and string.format("%d.%d", v.multi_channel_node_id or -1, v.end_point or -1) or tostring(v)
    end
    return "[" .. table.concat(s, ",") .. "]"
  end
  local last_get = {} -- device_id -> os.time() of our last SwitchBinary Get (keretlen-e a valasz)
  local function get_switch(dev, comp_id)
    last_get[dev.id] = os.time()
    dev:send_to_component(StbSwitchBinary:Get({}), comp_id or "main")
  end
  local pending = {} -- device_id -> { assoc = bool|nil, mca = bool|nil, repaired = bool }
  local function check_lifeline(drv, dev, repaired)
    pending[dev.id] = { repaired = repaired }
    dev:send(StbAssoc:Get({grouping_identifier = 1}))
    dev.thread:call_with_delay(3, function() dev:send(StbMca:Get({grouping_identifier = 1})) end)
    dev.thread:call_with_delay(20, function()
      local p = pending[dev.id]
      if p == nil then return end
      pending[dev.id] = nil
      if p.assoc or p.mca then return end
      if p.repaired then
        stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: lifeline a javitas utan is hianyzik (assoc=%s mca=%s)",
          tostring(dev.label), tostring(p.assoc), tostring(p.mca)))
        return
      end
      stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: lifeline (group 1) hianyzik -> Association Set hub=%d",
        tostring(dev.label), hub_id(drv)))
      dev:send(StbAssoc:Set({grouping_identifier = 1, node_ids = {hub_id(drv)}}))
      dev.thread:call_with_delay(5, function() check_lifeline(drv, dev, true) end)
    end, "st-edge lifeline check")
  end
  local disp = switch.zwave_dispatcher
  local orig_dispatch = disp.dispatch
  disp.dispatch = function(self, drv, dev, cmd, ...)
    local p = pending[dev.id]
    if p ~= nil and cmd.cmd_id == 0x03 and (cmd.cmd_class == 0x85 or cmd.cmd_class == 0x8E)
        and cmd.args and cmd.args.grouping_identifier == 1 then
      local hub, has = hub_id(drv), false
      for _, n in ipairs(cmd.args.node_ids or {}) do if n == hub then has = true end end
      for _, n in ipairs(cmd.args.multi_channel_nodes or {}) do if n.multi_channel_node_id == hub then has = true end end
      if cmd.cmd_class == 0x85 then p.assoc = has else p.mca = has end
      stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: %s group 1 = %s %s (hub=%d)%s", tostring(dev.label),
        cmd.cmd_class == 0x85 and "Association" or "MultiChannelAssociation", ids_str(cmd.args.node_ids),
        ids_str(cmd.args.multi_channel_nodes), hub, p.repaired and " [javitas utan]" or ""))
    end
    -- Az 1. csatornan (Q1) kivuli endpoint (I2/I3 bemenet, homero) switch-uzenetet a driver a main-re
    -- irna -> hamis "be" (pl. ejjel 0 W mellett). Ezeket nem dolgozzuk fel, hanem a relet visszaolvassuk.
    if is_qubino_single(dev) and (cmd.cmd_class == 0x20 or cmd.cmd_class == 0x25) then
      local a = cmd.args or {}
      local ch = cmd.src_channel or 0
      local ignore = ch > 1 and (cmd.cmd_id == 0x01 or cmd.cmd_id == 0x03)
      local unsolicited = os.time() - (last_get[dev.id] or 0) > 5
      local v = a.target_value or a.value
      local changed = (v == 0) ~= (dev:get_latest_state("main", "switch", "switch") == "off")
      if ignore or unsolicited or changed then
        stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: cc=0x%02X cmd=0x%02X ep=%d value=%s target=%s%s%s", tostring(dev.label),
          cmd.cmd_class, cmd.cmd_id, ch, tostring(a.value), tostring(a.target_value), unsolicited and " (keretlen)" or "",
          ignore and " -> elnyomva, visszaolvasas" or ""))
      end
      if ignore then
        last_get[dev.id] = os.time()
        dev:send(StbSwitchBinary:Get({}))
        return
      end
    end
    return orig_dispatch(self, drv, dev, cmd, ...)
  end
  local function check_all(drv)
    for _, dev in ipairs(drv:get_devices()) do
      if is_qubino_single(dev) then check_lifeline(drv, dev, false) end
    end
  end
  switch:call_with_delay(120, check_all, "st-edge lifeline start")
  switch:call_on_schedule(1800, check_all, "st-edge lifeline schedule")
  -- A rele kezi kapcsolaskor nem mindig jelent, es a lekerdezesre adott valasz is elveszhet, ezert
  -- percenkent lekerdezzuk a kapcsoloallapotot (1 Z-Wave keret/perc/eszkoz).
  switch:call_on_schedule(60, function(drv)
    for _, dev in ipairs(drv:get_devices()) do
      if is_qubino_single(dev) then get_switch(dev) end
    end
  end, "st-edge qubino switch poll")

  local last_mismatch = {}
  require("st_bridge").on_event(function(dev, comp_id, cap_id, attr, value)
    if cap_id ~= "powerMeter" or attr ~= "power" or type(value) ~= "number" or not is_qubino_single(dev) then return end
    local sw = dev:get_latest_state(comp_id, "switch", "switch")
    if not ((value >= 3 and sw == "off") or (value < 1 and sw == "on")) then return end
    if os.time() - (last_mismatch[dev.id] or 0) < 30 then return end
    last_mismatch[dev.id] = os.time()
    stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: %s W, de a kapcsolo %s -> visszaolvasas",
      tostring(dev.label), tostring(value), tostring(sw)))
    local function attempt(n)
      get_switch(dev, comp_id)
      dev.thread:call_with_delay(5, function()
        if dev:get_latest_state(comp_id, "switch", "switch") ~= sw then return end
        if n < 3 then return attempt(n + 1) end
        stb_log.warn(string.format("[st-edge] %s: 3 visszaolvasas utan is %s (%s W)", tostring(dev.label), tostring(sw), tostring(value)))
      end)
    end
    attempt(1)
  end)
end
switch:run()
